topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I just found out that Alex is moving across the country. It’s a big opportunity for them, a new job that could really launch their career. Of course, I want them to take it, but the thought of not seeing them regularly is hard to shake. We’ve been through so much together, and the idea of long-distance feels weird. I’m trying to focus on the positive—maybe this will push me to travel more, to visit them and explore a new place. I guess I’ll have to adjust my plans and find new ways to stay connected. It’s a change, but changes can be good, right? I just hope we can keep our bond as strong as it’s always been.
